nodes.title: AD&D Character Portrait Generator V2.4 - Basic Workflow
widgets_values:
AD&D Character Portrait Generator V2.4
--------------------------------------

A polished, plug-and-play workflow for **ComfyUI** that generates rich, stylized **RPG character portraits** — perfect for **AD&D**, **Pathfinder**, and any fantasy setting. Featuring a clean layout, custom controls, and my very own **RPG-Characters** node for detailed character customization.

Now easier than ever to use — **no dependencies**, no fuss, just results. 🎨⚔️

---

🧠 How to Install RPG-Characters Node

1. Open **ComfyUI Manager** (via sidebar or `custom_nodes` menu).
2. Navigate to the *Install Custom Nodes* tab.
3. Search for: `RPG-Characters`
4. Click **Install** – ZERO dependencies!!! (You're welcome. 😉)
5. Restart ComfyUI and you're ready to go.

---

🟨 Build Process 🟨

This workflow is designed to run **out-of-the-box**, but if you want to fine-tune things, here are the configurable parts grouped for convenience:

- 🟪 Flux Switch
  Added so you can Switch between FLUX workflow and SD /SDXL Workflow.

- 🟪 Seed Generator
  Added so you can Switch between Fixed and random seeds.

- 🟪 Empty Latent Images
  Default should be ok, but keep it square, keep it safe!.

- 🟪 Load SD / SDXL Checkpoint
  Optimized for Proteus v0.3 (https://civitai.com/models/267242?modelVersionId=343109)
  But feel free to use any SD/SDXL model you prefer.

- 🟪 Sampler + Scheduler + Steps
  For SD / SDXL - Recommended is:

  - Sampler - dpmpp_2m_sde
  - scheduler - exponential
  - Steps - 30
  
  For FLUX - Recommended is:

  - Sampler - euler
  - scheduler - beta
  - Steps - 12

  but pick whats best for your Checkpoints.

  (Steps end/start are calculated for optimal results based on steps input.
   Depending on your model and setup - don't go lower than 4)

- 🟪 PREP FLUX Checkpoints
  Self Explanatory - Set your Flux Models If you want to Use Flux.  This Works Very well in flux.

---

🟦 RPG Character Configuration 🟦

This is where the *magic* happens — powered by **custom RPG nodes** made specifically for immersive character creation.

- ⬜ RPG Art Style Selector
  Pick the art style you want for your character: Anime, Realistic, Dark Fantasy, etc.

- ⬜ RPG Character Builder
  Customize Race, Gender, Age, Class, Hair, Clothing, Emotion, Scene, and more.
  
  Now Includes DNA Locker:

  🧬 DNA Locker
  Your character's genetic playground. 🎲

  - 🎲 Re-roll individual traits — keep rolling until you find one you like.
  - 🎲 Re-roll the Master Seed — generate a completely new DNA combination.
  - 🧬 DNA Sculptor — blend the nearest three variants for finer control.
  - 👁️ Live feedback — DNA changes are shown immediately, so you can experiment
    before generating an image.
  - 🔢 Reproducible — the Master Seed lets you recreate the same DNA combination.

  In short: roll the dice, find a combination you like, sculpt it if you want
  more control, then run the workflow.

  ⚠️ DNA isn't an exact science...
  Diffusion models can be a little loose with genetics, so results won't always
  perfectly match the DNA Locker. DNA is fragile. Handle with care. 🧬😏

  Your character. Your DNA. Your dice.

---

🚀 That’s It!

Once you've tweaked your inputs (or left them at default), **just run the workflow** and enjoy your character portrait.

Happy questing! 🐉🛡️
